routing_warnings.description: This message requests square-footage-dependent package and bundle prices on the static pricing page, not a change to the deferred calculator.
This message reports that the bundle display shows one fixed price and requests category-specific displayed prices.
The client selects predefined package pricing for the pricing display rather than resuming or modifying the deferred calculator.
This acceptance resolves the proposed Basic package rates for the static square-footage pricing display.
The implementation claim concerns revisions to the Pricing page rather than the instant quote calculator.
This message asks where the existing Book a Session button should direct visitors; that navigation behavior belongs to the separate CTA-destination Requirement.
The implementation claim concerns completion of the Get a Quote form design, not routing of the Book a Session CTA.
The client's approval concerns the Get a Quote page design and does not verify the Book a Session CTA destination.
The square-footage tiers in this message are variables for the proposed dynamic quote calculator rather than the later predefined package-pricing display.
The request to avoid horizontal scrolling concerns the independently evolving mobile pricing-table layout.
The client's statement that the current pricing approach works well resolves the mobile table-layout discussion, not the package-rate matrix.
This message changes package and bundle prices by property square footage rather than the individual-service pricing breakdown.
The reported fixed-price problem concerns bundle pricing across square-footage categories.
The predefined four-package, four-category pricing matrix belongs to package square-footage pricing.
The proposed Basic package rates concern the package square-footage pricing matrix.
This client acceptance resolves the immediately preceding Basic package rate proposal.
In the immediately preceding context, this pricing-page revision claim concerns the package square-footage matrix.
The request for gallery-item hover animations belongs to the independent gallery hover-effects Requirement.
The request to disable hover animations on mobile belongs to the gallery hover-effects Requirement.
The request to avoid horizontal scrolling in the mobile pricing sheet belongs to the mobile pricing-table Requirement.
The request to correct homepage button destinations belongs to the homepage navigation-links Requirement.
Video support within the gallery is independently represented by the gallery video-integration Requirement.
Removing the homepage video while retaining the gallery video changes the homepage video-integration Requirement, not gallery browsing and organization.
The same message removes the independently tracked homepage video while retaining the Gallery video.
The request to emphasize the home-screen image by reducing the blue treatment is specific to the homepage rather than the sitewide image-focused design.
The client delegates selection and placement of supplied photos, which concerns concrete asset usage rather than the sitewide visual-emphasis constraint.
The claim that all website images were updated concerns the placement of client photo assets rather than implementation of the general image-focused design constraint.
The client delegates selection and placement of supplied photo assets; this changes asset-placement discretion rather than the service-to-image correspondence rule.
The agency's claim that all website images were updated follows the supplied-photo placement exchange and does not specifically establish that each listed service received a corresponding image.
The remaining requests concern replacing stock photos with supplied photos and selecting a homepage house image, not service-specific image correspondence.
The requirement that each listed service have a corresponding relevant image is independently testable and belongs to the service-specific image-mapping Requirement.
The client delegates selection and placement of supplied photos; this concerns client photo asset usage rather than the homepage overlay treatment.
The requests to replace stock photos with supplied photos and use a house photo on the homepage concern photo asset usage rather than the approved homepage overlay treatment.
The requested hover animations apply to Gallery-page items rather than the homepage gallery animation.
The request to disable mobile hover animations concerns Gallery-page hover effects, not the homepage gallery animation.
The Elementor limitation concerns device-specific hover effects and belongs to the Gallery Hover Effects Requirement.
The decision to retain the animations resolves the mobile hover-effects discussion rather than changing the homepage gallery animation.
The requested pricing-area control leading to detailed pricing is more specifically covered by the Detailed Pricing Link Requirement.
The request for homepage portfolio tiles to link to the gallery belongs to the separate Homepage Portfolio Tile Link Requirement.
The request for homepage buttons to link to the Gallery, Pricing, and Services pages concerns section navigation buttons, not the homepage portfolio tiles.
The implementation claim concerns homepage section buttons leading to their respective pages, not the portfolio-tile link.
